{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out the 6 QA rows and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the cleaned data
print(f"Number of rows after cleaning: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Unique channels in cleaned data: {df_clean['channel'].unique()}")

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum()
print("Total revenue by channel:")
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
best_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel}")
print(f"Highest revenue: {best_revenue}")"}
